spherical.label: The axis, $q = 1$
caption: The plane of $t$ and $r$ ($\theta = 0$, $\phi = 0$) of the Zipoy-Voorhees metric ($q = 1$, $m = 1$). The metric on it is $-f^{2}c^2dt^2 + f^{-2}dr^2$ with $f = 1 - 2m/r$, so the rays are $ct = \pm r_* + $ const with $r_* = r + 4m\ln(r/2m - 1) - 4m^2/(r - 2m)$, and no Christoffel symbol turns them out of the plane, so they are null geodesics.

The cones close as $f^{2}$ toward $r = 2m$, which a ray reaches only as $t \to \pm\infty$, though after a finite affine distance, since $r$ is an affine parameter along it. The Kretschmann scalar on the axis, $192m^2(r - 3m)^2/r^8$, vanishes at $r = 3m$ and is $3/(4m^4)$ at $r = 2m$.

spherical.label: The equatorial plane, $q = 1$

markers.legend: $r = 3\,m$, the narrowest circle about the axis

caption: The plane of $t$ and $r$ ($\theta = \pi/2$, $\phi = 0$) of the Zipoy-Voorhees metric ($q = 1$, $m = 1$). The metric on it is $-f^{2}c^2dt^2 + f^{-2}h^{-3}dr^2$ with $f = 1 - 2m/r$ and $h = (r - m)^2/(r(r - 2m))$, so a ray has $c\,dt/dr = \pm r^{7/2}/(\sqrt{r - 2m}\,(r - m)^3)$, and no Christoffel symbol turns it out of the plane, so the rays are null geodesics.

The cones close toward $r = 2m$, the ring, which every ingoing ray reaches in a finite time $t$ and where the Kretschmann scalar diverges as $(r - 2m)^{-6}$. The circle about the axis is narrowest at $r = 3m$.

spherical.label: The axis, $q = -1/2$
caption: The plane of $t$ and $r$ ($\theta = 0$, $\phi = 0$) of the Zipoy-Voorhees metric ($q = -1/2$, $m = 1$). The metric on it is $-f^{1/2}c^2dt^2 + f^{-1/2}dr^2$ with $f = 1 - 2m/r$, so the rays are $ct = \pm r_* + $ const with $r_* = \sqrt{r(r - 2m)} + 2m\ln\left(\sqrt{r} + \sqrt{r - 2m}\right)$, and no Christoffel symbol turns them out of the plane, so they are null geodesics.
The cones close as $f^{1/2}$ toward $r = 2m$, which every ingoing ray reaches in a finite time $t$ and where the Kretschmann scalar on the axis, $12m^2(r - 3m/2)^2/(r^5(r - 2m)^3)$, diverges.

spherical.label: The equatorial plane, $q = -1/2$
caption: The plane of $t$ and $r$ ($\theta = \pi/2$, $\phi = 0$) of the Zipoy-Voorhees metric ($q = -1/2$, $m = 1$). The metric on it is $-f^{1/2}c^2dt^2 + f^{-1/2}h^{3/4}dr^2$ with $f = 1 - 2m/r$ and $h = (r - m)^2/(r(r - 2m))$, so a ray has $c\,dt/dr = \pm f^{-7/8}(1 - m/r)^{3/4}$, and no Christoffel symbol turns it out of the plane, so the rays are null geodesics.
The cones close toward $r = 2m$, which every ingoing ray reaches in a finite time $t$ and where the Kretschmann scalar diverges as $(r - 2m)^{-3/2}$. The circles about the axis shrink to zero there.

prolate_spheroidal.label: The axis, $\delta = 2$
caption: The plane of $t$ and $x$ ($y = 1$, $\phi = 0$) of the Zipoy-Voorhees metric ($\delta = 2$, $m = 1$). The metric on it is $-f^{2}c^2dt^2 + m^2f^{-2}dx^2$ with $f = (x - 1)/(x + 1)$, so the rays are $ct = \pm r_* + $ const with $r_* = m\left(x + 4\ln(x - 1) - 4/(x - 1)\right)$, and no Christoffel symbol turns them out of the plane, so they are null geodesics.

The cones close as $f^{2}$ toward $x = 1$, which a ray reaches only as $t \to \pm\infty$, though after a finite affine distance, since $x$ is an affine parameter along it. The Kretschmann scalar on the axis, $192(x - 2)^2/(m^4(x + 1)^8)$, vanishes at $x = 2$ and is $3/(4m^4)$ at $x = 1$.

prolate_spheroidal.label: The equatorial plane, $\delta = 2$

markers.legend: $x = 2$, the narrowest circle about the axis

caption: The plane of $t$ and $x$ ($y = 0$, $\phi = 0$) of the Zipoy-Voorhees metric ($\delta = 2$, $m = 1$). The metric on it is $-f^{2}c^2dt^2 + m^2f^{-2}h^{-3}dx^2$ with $f = (x - 1)/(x + 1)$ and $h = x^2/(x^2 - 1)$, so a ray has $c\,dt/dx = \pm m(x + 1)^{7/2}/(\sqrt{x - 1}\,x^3)$, and no Christoffel symbol turns it out of the plane, so the rays are null geodesics.

The cones close toward $x = 1$, the ring, which every ingoing ray reaches in a finite time $t$ and where the Kretschmann scalar diverges as $(x - 1)^{-6}$. The circle about the axis is narrowest at $x = 2$.

prolate_spheroidal.label: The axis, $\delta = 1/2$
caption: The plane of $t$ and $x$ ($y = 1$, $\phi = 0$) of the Zipoy-Voorhees metric ($\delta = 1/2$, $m = 1$). The metric on it is $-f^{1/2}c^2dt^2 + m^2f^{-1/2}dx^2$ with $f = (x - 1)/(x + 1)$, so the rays are $ct = \pm r_* + $ const with $r_* = m\left(\sqrt{x^2 - 1} + 2\ln\left(\sqrt{x + 1} + \sqrt{x - 1}\right)\right)$, and no Christoffel symbol turns them out of the plane, so they are null geodesics.
The cones close as $f^{1/2}$ toward $x = 1$, which every ingoing ray reaches in a finite time $t$ and where the Kretschmann scalar on the axis, $12(x - 1/2)^2/(m^4(x + 1)^5(x - 1)^3)$, diverges.

caption: The plane of $t$ and $x$ ($y = 0$, $\phi = 0$) of the Zipoy-Voorhees metric ($\delta = 1/2$, $m = 1$). The metric on it is $-f^{1/2}c^2dt^2 + m^2f^{-1/2}h^{3/4}dx^2$ with $f = (x - 1)/(x + 1)$ and $h = x^2/(x^2 - 1)$, so a ray has $c\,dt/dx = \pm m\,f^{-7/8}(x/(x + 1))^{3/4}$, and no Christoffel symbol turns it out of the plane, so the rays are null geodesics.
